result.instructions: Tools for smallinvoice, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still open, and who owes me the most?"; "Show all invoices for the contact ACME GmbH from this year."; "How many hours did we book on each project last month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes smallinvoice data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smallinvoice_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smallinvoice_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smallinvoice_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. smallinvoice_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.description: The smallinvoice account the API client belongs to (the owner's id and details). A cheap check that the connection works. GET /auth/owner.

tools.name: smallinvoice_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers and suppliers): name, type (company or person), relation, e-mail, currency. Add with=main_address for the address. Needs the "contact" scope. GET /contacts. Returns count, total, next_offset (pass it as offset for the next page) and the items.

filter.description: Optional filter as a JSON object string, e.g. {"currency":"CHF"}; combine with {"and":[...]} / {"or":[...]}. Comparators go before the value: "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "!" (not), "~" (contains), e.g. {"name":"~ACME"}. Unknown field names are answered with HTTP 400.

sort.description: Optional sort: 'name' ascending, '-name' descending, '-surname,name' for several.

with.description: Optional extra fields to include, comma separated (e.g. 'main_address' on contacts).

tools.name: smallinvoice_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new company contact (customer) in smallinvoice, with its main address. Needs the "contact" scope. POST /contacts. Nothing is sent to anyone. Private persons are not supported here (smallinvoice needs more fields for them): create those in smallinvoice. Check smallinvoice_list_contacts first so you do not create a duplicate.

name.description: Company name, as printed on documents.

country.description: Main address: ISO country code, e.g. CH.

relation.description: Relation codes (default ['CL'] = client, as in the vendor's example). See the vendor docs for the others.

currency.description: ISO currency, e.g. CHF or EUR.

tools.name: smallinvoice_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new invoice for a contact. Needs the "invoice" scope. POST /receivables/invoices. It is only created: it is NOT sent by e-mail or post and its status is not changed; the user reviews it in smallinvoice. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two invoices. Use smallinvoice_list_contacts / smallinvoice_list_units first for the ids.

contact_address_id.description: The id of the contact's address to print (smallinvoice_list_contact_addresses, or main_address_id on the contact).

language.description: Document language: de, en, fr or it.

price.description: Unit price (net, in the invoice currency).

type.description: Position type (default 'N' = normal, as in the vendor's example).

catalog_type.description: Catalog type (default 'P', as in the vendor's example).
